# Puzzle 009

## Note

- Your solution must work for all possible blocking decisions your opponent could make.
- All cards remaining in your library are Swamps.

## Your Game State

### Hand

- Brilliant Spectrum
  - Mana cost: {3}{U}
  - Sorcery
  - Converge — Draw X cards, where X is the number of colors of mana spent to cast this spell. Then discard two cards.
- Horror of the Broken Lands
  - Mana cost: {4}{B}
  - Creature - Horror, 4/4
  - Whenever you cycle or discard another card, this creature gets +2/+1 until end of turn. Cycling {B}.
- Elder Deep-Fiend
  - Mana cost: {8}
  - Creature - Eldrazi Octopus, 5/6
  - Flash. Emerge {5}{U}{U}. When you cast this spell, tap up to four target permanents.
- Floodwaters
  - Mana cost: {4}{U}{U}
  - Sorcery
  - Return up to two target creatures to their owners' hands. Cycling {2}.

### Battlefield

- Shadowstorm Vizier
  - Mana cost: {U}{B}
  - Creature - Human Cleric, 1/3
  - Flying. Whenever you cycle or discard a card, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
- Archfiend of Ifnir
  - Mana cost: {3}{B}{B}
  - Creature - Demon, 5/4
  - Flying. Whenever you cycle or discard another card, put a -1/-1 counter on each creature your opponents control. Cycling {2}.
- Stromkirk Condemned
  - Mana cost: {B}{B}
  - Creature - Vampire Horror, 2/2
  - Discard a card: Vampires you control get +1/+1 until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.
- 4x Island
- 3x Swamp

### Library

- All remaining cards in your library are Swamps.

### Graveyard and Exile

- No cards are shown.

  - Mana cost: {2}{G}
  - Creature - Human Scout, 3/2
  - Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, investigate. Whenever you sacrifice a Clue, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

## Objective

Win this turn.
solution_text:
1. Cast Brilliant Spectrum (ideally using both colours, but it doesn't actually matter.) Discarding two cards triggers Archfiend of Ifnir's ability twice, and when each of these counters are placed on opposing creatures, Winding Constrictor adds another. In total, each opposing creature gets -4/-4 during this step. Rishkar and Tireless Tracker die. Shadowstorm Vizier also triggers twice, and gets +2/+2, and is now a 3/5.
2. Cycle Horror of the Broken Lands. Your opponent's remaining creatures each get -2/-2 worth of counters, and Shadowstorm Vizier gets bumped up to 4/6.
3. Cycle Floodwaters. You opponent's remaining creatures each get -2/-2 worth of counters (Winding Constrictor dies), and Shadowstorm Vizier gets bumped up to 5/7.
4. Discard any card remaining in your hand to Stromkirk Condemned's ability. This gives it one +1/+1 counter to make it a 3/3, gives your opponent's remaining creatures another -1/-1 worth of counters (killing the Verdurous Gearhulk), and Shadowstorm Vizier gets bumped up to 6/8.
5. With a board clear of blockers, attack with your 5/4 Archfriend, 6/8 Vizier, and 3/3 Vampire, for a total of 14 damage for lethal.
